start.title: [TODO:ru] From the Edge
start.text:
[TODO:ru] You stand outside the village.
A teacher passes by.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Rise
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Mercy walks past only once.
Go to him.

approach.title: [TODO:ru] Through the Crowd
approach.text:
[TODO:ru] Faces recoil. Voices hush.
The path narrows.

anger_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Let It Go
anger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their fear is not your battle.
Look ahead.

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Don't Retreat
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He is near. Reach him.
Faith calls you forward.

kneel.title: [TODO:ru] On Your Knees
kneel.text:
[TODO:ru] You fall before him, trembling.
His eyes meet yours.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Speak with Faith
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Healing is mercy, not a debt.
Ask gently.

plea.title: [TODO:ru] If You Are Willing
plea.text:
[TODO:ru] "You can make me clean."
He looks at you with love.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Lift Your Eyes
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He has not turned away.
Trust him.

touch.title: [TODO:ru] He Reaches Out
touch.text:
[TODO:ru] No one has touched you in years.
His hand draws near.

pull_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Receive Mercy
pull_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He knows. He came anyway.
Let him.

warn_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] He Is Not Afraid
warn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His love is greater than fear.
Let him near.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Give Thanks
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The gift is his.
Return praise.

send.title: [TODO:ru] Go and Live
send.text:
[TODO:ru] "Show yourself to the priest."
You step into the light.
